versions.changelog:
Initial release of the LinkedIn Poster skill.

- Post text updates to your LinkedIn profile or company page via OAuth 2.0.
- Supports both command line and WhatsApp triggers.
- Automatic token management with 60-day expiry and re-authorization prompt.
- Requires LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID and LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.
- Company page posts supported by fuzzy matching administered organizations.
- Uses a production-ready hosted callback server for OAuth authentication.
